purpose: Ingredient nutrition research queue. Entries are identities to resolve, not populated nutrition records; no nutrient values are supplied.
coverageScope: Broad, expandable coverage of common produce, grains, fats, proteins, dairy, pantry ingredients, beverage ingredients, and food additives. This is not every global species, cultivar, preparation, or branded SKU.
basisPolicy: Population must use per 100 g edible portion in the stated food state. Keep raw, cooked, drained, reconstituted, concentration, fat percentage, and fortification differences explicit. Resolve brands and formulations before admitting branded or composition-dependent records.

priorityDefinitions.1: Common building blocks and requested specialty products. Populate first.
priorityDefinitions.2: Broader everyday coverage. Populate after the priority 1 core.
priorityDefinitions.3: Less common produce, specialty proteins, or additive details. Populate after higher-use foods unless needed by a current recipe.

populationPolicy: All rows start queued. Record source identity, edition or date, nutrient units, individual value status, and evidence at population time. Never treat an absent field as zero. Generic profiles may be reused only when the food state and material qualifiers match. Manufacturer-specific or unresolved composition entries cannot be published as exact profiles until identity is resolved.
aliasPolicy: Aliases are discovery terms, not proof of identity. Different raw, cooked, drained, fat-percentage, fortified or branded records can share a search term. Require matching state and material qualifiers before confirming a link; never auto-confirm from an alias alone.
